englishTranslation: Hanoi chicken, egg, and pork noodle soup
atAGlance: Bún thang is a delicate Hanoi noodle soup layered with shredded chicken, egg ribbons, pork sausage, herbs, and clear broth. It is refined rather than fiery.
whatItIs: Bún thang is a Hanoi soup where thin rice vermicelli sits under careful strips of chicken, egg, pork sausage, herbs, and clear broth.
howToEnjoy: Keep the first spoonful gentle. Add chili only after tasting the broth, because the pleasure is in the layered clean flavors.
howLocalsOrder: Bún thang is a delicate Hanoi-style bowl, so locals do not bury it under chili right away. Order it by name and let the chicken, egg ribbons, and pork sausage stay clear and tidy.
worthKnowing: Bún thang is associated with Hanoi cooking and a more delicate soup style than many southern or central bowls.
goodToKnow: The bowl can include pork sausage, egg, and dried-shrimp flavor. It is not just chicken soup.
travelerCaution: May include pork, egg, and dried shrimp.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô bún thang.
orderLine.english: I’d like one bowl of Hanoi chicken, egg, and pork noodle soup.
orderLine.pronunciation: chaw toy moht toh boon tang
